content.text: Ontario is member 7, Quebec is member 6, and the unemployment rate is member 7 in the labour force characteristics dimension. I'll fetch September 2026 for both provinces, seasonally adjusted, 15+ years, total gender, estimate.

input.answer: In September 2026 the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate was higher in Ontario than in Quebec. Ontario was 7.0% and Quebec was 6.0%, a gap of 1.0 percentage point (7.0 − 6.0). These are the Labour Force Survey monthly seasonally adjusted rates for people aged 15 and over, both sexes (table 14-10-0287). The table's data runs to 2026-09, so September is the latest month available. Source: https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=1410028701
